commit b6592383c95563b20244b3be5a9d991ce2fb78ac
Author:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Feb 3 09:41:31 2026 -0500
Commit:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Tue Feb 3 09:41:31 2026 -0500

    Bug 2010499 - Run fetch-content from Gecko specific location. r=sking
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D280180

diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile
index a6032389819..507f97168cf 100644
--- a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile
@@ -6,7 +6,8 @@ RUN mkdir /scripts/
 WORKDIR /scripts/
 
 # Copy everything in the docker/tb-flatpak folder but the Dockerfile
-COPY [^D]* /scripts/
+# Use globs to avoid accidentally copying the injected run-task/ directory.
+COPY *.sh *.c *.ini *.in *.svg /scripts/
 
 # Copy required recipes
 # %include comm/taskcluster/docker/recipes
@@ -15,8 +16,8 @@ COPY topsrcdir/comm/taskcluster/docker/recipes/fluent_requirements.txt /scripts/
 COPY topsrcdir/comm/taskcluster/docker/recipes/build_desktop_file.py /scripts/build_desktop_file.py
 COPY topsrcdir/comm/taskcluster/docker/recipes/org.mozilla.thunderbird.desktop.jinja2 /scripts/org.mozilla.thunderbird.desktop.jinja2
 
-# %include third_party/python/taskcluster_taskgraph/taskgraph/run-task/fetch-content
-ADD topsrcdir/third_party/python/taskcluster_taskgraph/taskgraph/run-task/fetch-content /scripts/fetch-content
+# Setup upstream `run-task` and `fetch-content`
+# %include-run-task
 
 # Set up Python virtual environment
 ENV VENV_DIR="/scripts"
diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
index 8084e26ebf7..a75637ec604 100755
--- a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
@@ -63,7 +63,7 @@ done
 (
 source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/venv/bin/activate"
 
-python3 /scripts/fetch-content task-artifacts --dest "${WORKSPACE}"
+python3 /builds/worker/bin/fetch-content task-artifacts --dest "${WORKSPACE}"
 
 [[ "$FLATPAK_BRANCH" = "stable" ]] && VERSION_FLAG="--esr" || VERSION_FLAG="--beta"
 python3 "${SCRIPT_DIR}/build_desktop_file.py"               \
diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-snap/Dockerfile b/taskcluster/docker/tb-snap/Dockerfile
index 5b2e7277757..ec972143704 100644
--- a/taskcluster/docker/tb-snap/Dockerfile
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-snap/Dockerfile
@@ -43,7 +43,8 @@ RUN mkdir /scripts/
 WORKDIR /scripts/
 
 # Copy everything in the docker/tb-snap folder but the Dockerfile
-COPY [^D]* /scripts/
+# Use globs to avoid accidentally copying the injected run-task/ directory.
+COPY *.sh *.ini *.json *.in /scripts/
 
 # Copy required recipes
 # %include comm/taskcluster/docker/recipes
@@ -52,8 +53,8 @@ COPY topsrcdir/comm/taskcluster/docker/recipes/fluent_requirements.txt /scripts/
 COPY topsrcdir/comm/taskcluster/docker/recipes/build_desktop_file.py /scripts/build_desktop_file.py
 COPY topsrcdir/comm/taskcluster/docker/recipes/org.mozilla.thunderbird.desktop.jinja2 /scripts/org.mozilla.thunderbird.desktop.jinja2
 
-# %include third_party/python/taskcluster_taskgraph/taskgraph/run-task/fetch-content
-ADD topsrcdir/third_party/python/taskcluster_taskgraph/taskgraph/run-task/fetch-content /scripts/fetch-content
+# Setup upstream `run-task` and `fetch-content`
+# %include-run-task
 
 # Set up Python virtual environment
 RUN /scripts/make_venv.sh /scripts/fluent_requirements.txt
diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-snap/repack.sh b/taskcluster/docker/tb-snap/repack.sh
index 2fb736274b3..210dc673827 100755
--- a/taskcluster/docker/tb-snap/repack.sh
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-snap/repack.sh
@@ -47,7 +47,7 @@ done
 (
 source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/venv/bin/activate"
 
-python3 /scripts/fetch-content task-artifacts --dest "${WORKSPACE}"
+python3 /builds/worker/bin/fetch-content task-artifacts --dest "${WORKSPACE}"
 
 python3 "${SCRIPT_DIR}/build_desktop_file.py"               \
   -o "${WORKSPACE}/org.mozilla.thunderbird.desktop"         \
title: Bug 2010499 - Run fetch-content from Gecko specific location. r=sking
